{{Current events header|2015|05|17}}

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*A suicide attack by the [[Taliban]] kills three and injures at least eighteen outside [[Kabul International Airport]] in [[Afghanistan]]. [http://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-32771099 (BBC News)]
*The [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant|Islamic State]] reportedly seizes control of the [[Iraq|Iraqi]] city of [[Ramadi]] after the retreat of government forces. [http://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-middle-east-32773780 (BBC News)]

;Arts and culture
*[[Pope Francis]] of the [[Roman Catholic Church]] canonises two [[saint]]s from [[Palestine]], Sister [[Mariam Baouardy]] and Sister [[Marie Alphonsine Ghattas]]. [http://tenplay.com.au/news/national/latest-news/latest-news/pope-canonizes-2-saints-from-19th-century-palestine (AP via Ten Play)]
*[[2015 Billboard Music Awards]]
**American [[pop music]] star [[Taylor Swift]] wins 8 awards at the Billboard Music Awards including top artist. [http://www.independent.co.uk/arts-entertainment/music/news/billboard-music-awards-2015-winners-list-in-full-taylor-swift-sam-smith-and-one-direction-sweep-board-in-las-vegas-10257503.html (''The Independent'')]

;Law and crime
*[[2015 Twin Peaks shooting]]
**At least 9 people are killed and 18 injured, some by law enforcement and others in gunfire exchanges, in a [[shootout]] between rival [[biker gang]]s in [[Waco]], [[Texas]], at the Twin Peaks Restaurant. [http://www.kwtx.com/home/headlines/Waco-Shooting-Near-Twin-Peaks-In-Waco-304043711.html (KWTX)], [http://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2015/may/17/biker-gang-shooting-waco-texas (''The Guardian'')]
**At least 25 members of [[outlaw motorcycle gang]]s are being held as witnesses and possible suspects. [http://www.statesman.com/news/news/local/biker-gang-shootout-leaves-nine-dead-in-waco/nmJCC/?ecmp=statesman_social_twitter_2014_sfp (''Austin American-Statesman'')]

;Health
*A 'groundbreaking' combination of drugs which could improve the quality of life and life expectancy of [[cystic fibrosis]] sufferers is trialed. [http://www.bbc.co.uk/news/health-32755065 (BBC News)]

;Politics
* A [[2015 Macedonian protests|large rally]] is held by tens of thousands of protestors in [[Skopje]], [[Republic of Macedonia|Macedonia]], as part of the ongoing protests against Prime Minister [[Nikola Gruevski]]. [http://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-32771233 (BBC News)]

;Science
*[[Roscosmos]] manages to restart the engines of the Progress spacecraft and to correct the orbit of the [[International Space Station]]. [http://news.yahoo.com/russia-successful-second-attempt-start-progress-spacecraft-013723064.html (AFP via Yahoo! News)]

;Sports
* In ice hockey, [[Canada men's national ice hockey team|Canada]] wins gold over [[Russia men's national ice hockey team|Russia]] at the [[2015 IIHF World Championship]], while the [[United States men's national ice hockey team|United States]] wins bronze over the [[Czech Republic men's national ice hockey team|Czech Republic]]. [http://www.sportsnet.ca/hockey/nhl/canada-routs-russia-for-world-championships-gold/ (Sportsnet)]
*[[2014–15 A-League]]
**In football, [[Melbourne Victory FC]] defeats [[Sydney FC]] 3-0 in the grand final of the [[Australia]]n [[A-League]] with Victory captain [[Mark Milligan]] winning man-of-the-match. [http://www.abc.net.au/news/2015-05-18/inspirational-milligan-stamps-his-class-on-a-league-grand-final/6476444 (ABC News)]
